svg.title: Angleford, designer who codes
svg.desc: I make calm, local-first tools for the things that annoy me. A display of small glowing crosses shows one object for each tool in turn. Projects: Tempro, Moonbow, V2pn, Claude Profile Switcher, Codex Switcher, earn›line, Cutoff, Fount, Pinterest Plus Plus, Blackboard Text, orvey.

g.text: A fast, quiet video and music player.
A simple VPN client for Windows and macOS.
Several Claude accounts, all signed in.
Several Codex accounts, limits in view.
A local-first income ledger for iPhone.
A calm trainer for preflop decisions.
The fonts from any website, as TTF and OTF.
Images and concepts inside your AI chat.
